purpose: Define visible structured error semantics for canonical reading, validation and runtime-boundary failures so failures preserve cause, affected refs and cleanup state instead of collapsing into silent fallback behavior.

topics.name: Errors
topics.purpose: Define visible structured error semantics for canonical reading, validation and runtime-boundary failures so failures preserve cause, affected refs and cleanup state instead of collapsing into silent fallback behavior.

semantics.visibility_rule: Boundary failures remain visible to the caller/validator.
semantics.fallback_rule: Error handling does not silently invent semantics or broaden authority.
semantics.cleanup_rule: If runtime state/gates/resources were acquired before failure, cleanup state is explicit.
semantics.provenance_rule: Errors preserve machine-readable affected refs and causal provenance.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant meaning is explicit structured canonical data and is not reconstructed by hidden heuristics.
